steps.en: Clone the repo and install its Python dependencies
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，安装 Python 依赖

steps.en: Export an LLM key and a search-API key
steps.zh: 设置一个大模型 key 和一个搜索 API key

steps.en: Start the server, open localhost:8000 and type your research question
steps.zh: 启动服务，打开 localhost:8000，输入调研问题

steps.en: Plans: turns the question into a set of sub-questions
steps.zh: 规划：把问题拆成一组子问题

steps.en: Searches, scrapes and filters sources for each sub-question, tracking every source
steps.zh: 逐个子问题搜索、抓取、过滤来源，并记下每个出处

steps.en: Writes a cited report from the summaries, exportable to PDF, Word or Markdown
steps.zh: 根据摘要写出带引用的报告，可导出 PDF、Word、Markdown

value.en: A multi-page, cited research report in minutes instead of an afternoon of tab-hopping
value.zh: 几分钟拿到一份带引用的多页报告，不用再花一下午来回翻标签页

sources: https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher#installation (git clone; export OPENAI_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY; pip install -r requirements.txt; python -m uvicorn main:app --reload; visit http://localhost:8000)
https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher#architecture (planner generates research questions, execution agents gather information, publisher aggregates into a report)
https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher#features (export reports to PDF, Word and other formats)
